records.title: Portfolio research
records.maturity: Dated screening/underwriting and limited in-sample risk comparison
records.summary: Dated numeric screening distinguishes population coverage from filing-level underwriting. Adversarial reviews separate evidence, concentration risk and valuation assumptions. Historical diversification comparisons use constant daily target weights with no costs or taxes; bear/base/bull outputs are forecasts.
what_remains: Current decision inputs and execution assumptions would require a separately scoped refresh

records.title: Hybrid AI design
records.summary: The review proposes bounded disclosure-fact extraction beside deterministic calculations and risk enforcement. Its economic contribution would need a frozen prospective comparison and cheap text/numerical baselines. No new autonomous trader, predictive model or return test was implemented.
